name: Brook Music Bot
description: Soul King Telegram music bot in pure Rust with multi-platform streaming (YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud, Direct Links) via IP-ban-safe public APIs.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram numeric user ID of the bot owner

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the /admin HTTP dashboard (Basic auth)

INVIDIOUS_INSTANCES.description: Comma-separated public Invidious hosts for YouTube (rotated to avoid IP bans)

PIPED_INSTANCES.description: Comma-separated public Piped API hosts for YouTube fallback

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Spotify app client ID (https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard) - enables Spotify search/links

SOUNDCLOUD_CLIENT_ID.description: SoundCloud API client_id - enables SoundCloud search/links

RESOLVER_CACHE_TTL_SECS.description: TTL (seconds) for in-memory search-result caching to reduce upstream requests

MAX_DIRECT_STREAM_MB.description: Max size (MB) for direct audio streams to prevent unbounded downloads

ALLOWED_DIRECT_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated allowed redirect hosts for direct links (optional)

YOUTUBE_ENABLED.description: Set false to disable YouTube search (Invidious/Piped)

YT_DLP_ENABLED.description: Use yt-dlp subprocess for YouTube audio extraction (requires python3 + pip buildpack)

YT_DLP_TIMEOUT_SECS.description: Max seconds allowed for a yt-dlp extraction attempt

MAX_CONCURRENT_RESOLUTIONS.description: Max concurrent upstream track resolutions (rate-limit / IP-ban protection)

TG_API_ID.description: Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org/api - required for voice chat streaming (assistant account)

TG_API_HASH.description: Telegram API hash from https://my.telegram.org/api - required for voice chat streaming (assistant account)

ASSISTANT_SESSION_STRING.description: Session string for the assistant user account (run `brook-music-bot --export-session` locally to generate). Enables real audio in voice chats.
